system.special: <p><strong><p><strong>&lt;p&gt;&lt;strong&gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Animal Form: </strong> </strong> &lt;/strong&gt; In animal form, a lycanthrope can be harmed only by magical weapons, silvered weapons, or spells. It cannot speak normal languages, but can speak with normal animals of its weretype. Human Form: In human form a lycanthrope often looks somewhat like its wereform. It can speak and use weapons normally. Summon Animals: Any lycanthrope can summon 1d2 normal animals of its type; they arrive in 1d4 rounds. Wolfsbane: If hit by wolfsbane, the lycanthrope must save vs. poison or flee in fear.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Hug: If both claws hit one target in a round, add 2d8 damage.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&amp;lt;p&amp;gt;Human Form AC: 8.&amp;lt;/p&amp;gt;&lt;/p&gt;</p></p>
system.description: Werebears are highly intelligent even in animal form and may be friendly if approached peacefully. In combat, if both paws hit the same target in a round, they can hug for an extra 2d8 damage. They summon any bears in the area. In human form their AC is 8.
